Subject: Cloud marketplace buying route + procurement next steps (post-demo)

Hi Liam — great to meet earlier and thanks for the demo time. Quick recap and recommended next steps so procurement can start evaluating options: 

Summary of what we discussed
- Primary goal: POC integration (2–4 weeks) using Redwood hosted inference for PHI-minimized clinical summarization.
- Key decision: preferred commercial path (AWS Marketplace vs PO/card).
- Procurement constraints: monthly invoicing preferred but procurement team needs standard terms and SOC2 evidence.

Procurement paths we covered
1) AWS Marketplace (preferred by your finance team)
   - Pros: marketplace billing, simplified purchasing, often faster payment cycles.
   - Cons: listing / procurement setup can take ~2–4 weeks if we need to onboard account-specific entitlements.
2) Standard PO (direct Redwood invoice)
   - Pros: immediate contract signature (DocuSign), flexible terms.
   - Cons: procurement cycles can be longer (3–6 weeks) for PO approval depending on legal.
3) Card / corporate card
   - Pros: fastest for an initial POC; limited paperwork.
   - Cons: not ideal for production or larger commitment.

What we need from Cynergi to qualify the path
- Preferred billing route: AWS Marketplace, PO, or card? (If marketplace, please confirm your AWS payer account ID)
- Billing contact & procurement email (I cc'd procurement@cynergi.co in case that’s the right inbox)
- Any required templates (SOW/PO language) or specific review items (data processing addendum, PCI/PHI clauses).

Attachments: I attached a draft SOW (redwood_sow_draft_v1.pdf) and a short procurement checklist (cynergi_procurement_checklist.xlsx) to speed review.

Proposed next steps
- You: confirm preferred buying route and share procurement contact by EOD Mon 3 Aug.
- We (Redwood): if marketplace is preferred, we’ll pull the AWS marketplace onboarding notes and timeline; if PO preferred, we’ll generate a DocuSign SOW editable for legal.
- Align calendar: suggest a 30-min procurement sync next week with Avery (billing/ops) and Monica (security) — is Tue 4 Aug 9:00 PT open?

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from procurement/product side: 

1) Marketplace preference
We strongly prefer AWS Marketplace billing if the listing will support a subscription model vs a metered per-token line item. Our central finance team wants the charge to come via marketplace (simpler to reconcile). If Redwood can offer a SaaS subscription in the marketplace that maps to our expected monthly spend for the POC, that's ideal.

2) Payer details
I don’t have the payer account ID at hand; procurement@cynergi.co will pull that and loop in our AWS account owner (Marta Ruiz).

3) Commercial items
- We need to confirm whether Redwood supports monthly invoicing through the marketplace (we expect so) and what billing granularity looks like (subscription vs usage).
- For PO route: our legal will push some redlines around indemnity & data handling; they will want the SOW and any DPA language up front.

4) Timeline
For a POC, marketplace would likely shorten the path but we still need to validate listing availability and entitlements. If Marketplace is unavailable, we’ll fall back to a PO. Our internal procurement lead says they could move in ~2 weeks if marketplace works, ~4–6 weeks if we need a PO.

I’m cc’ing procurement@cynergi.co as requested — can you also include an estimated date for a marketplace listing (if Redwood needs to create one) and any required documents for SOC2 evidence?

Thanks,
Liam
Head of Product Partnerships | Cynergi Health

Hey all — quick readout from marketplace/finance ops: 

- Current state: Redwood already has an AWS Marketplace seller account and a generic SaaS subscription listing live. We can offer two common configurations:
  1) Marketplace SaaS subscription (monthly charge): quickest for customers that want a recurring charge on their AWS bill. We can map the POC to a monthly tier that approximates forecasted usage.
  2) Metered (per-token) listing: requires us to enable metering integration; still supported but adds ~1 week of engineering ops to enable reporting pipelines.

- Timeline: If we use the existing SaaS subscription listing and create a customer-specific entitlement, typically ~3–7 business days to provision and validate (assuming the customer provides their AWS payer ID and there are no special entitlements). If we need new metered metering, plan +7–10 business days.

- PO fallback: If Cynergi needs a PO, we can issue DocuSign SOW today (attached SOW v1) and finance will process net-30 terms; procurement cycles vary on their side.

Recommended path for this POC
- Short-term: use Marketplace SaaS subscription (monthly) to get running quickly.
- Parallel: start a DocuSign SOW so legal has something to review (reduces friction later if they require PO).

Action items
- Cynergi: share AWS payer ID and confirm preferred monthly tier for POC (reply to this thread).
- Soojin: book 30-min procurement sync (I can join) — if Tue 4 Aug 9:00 PT works for Cynergi, I’ll confirm calendar invite.
- Redwood: I attached the redwood_marketplace_onboarding_notes.pdf for Cynergi’s procurement team and reattached SOW v1.

Avery Johnson
